title: Special-Order Lines and the Change-Order Fee
content:
# Special-Order Lines and the Change-Order Fee

Window Replacement Contracts estimating rate. The change-order fee for the most recent customer change order is multiplied by a special-order share read from the lines of that change order:

| Lines in the change order | Special-order share |
|---|---|
| An exterior color line (with or without other lines) | Factory-paint share, 1.5 |
| A laminated glass or obscure glass line, and no exterior color line | Specialty-glass share, 1.25 |
| Neither | 1 |

The share multiplies the fee before it is rounded to the cent.

## Combinations (hypothetical change orders)

- Exterior color and laminated glass together: 1.5, since an exterior color line is present.
- Obscure glass and grilles: 1.25.
- Tempered glass only: 1.
